entries.title: vkeys - public, {{vkeys.version}}
entries.summary: A Rust key store where named profiles inject credentials into a fixed command, with no command that prints a value. Tier 2 is a local OpenRouter broker behind a use-only token. 30 tests pass; the Windows SYSTEM and Linux ARM64 boundaries were both verified.

entries.title: Fixture - live
entries.summary: A local-first harness that drives FreeCAD and Blender through one schema-validated tool contract. Gate PASS at 140 pytest, FreeCAD 92/0, Blender 29/0; two scripted STEP/STL desk cases.

entries.title: AI Security Layer (AISL) - agent execution runtime
entries.summary: A capability-gated execution layer where the model cannot grant itself authority. Policy evaluation, taint tracking, egress DLP, and a signed hash-chained audit log, documented as 39 security claims, 32 ADRs, and 716 tests.

entries.title: eyewright - {{eyewright.version}}
entries.summary: A local-first decision core published to PyPI: a measured committee of local models behind one typed call. In a 2,000-decision replay, the selected policy reached 88.9% acted accuracy at 22.5% coverage.

entries.title: mcp-weight - published to npm
entries.summary: A read-only CLI that reports the context cost of MCP tool schemas across six clients. 517 downloads in its first month; a broken server stays a row instead of failing the scan.

entries.title: Living State Machine - research closure
entries.summary: A local-first LLM memory system with six ablatable mechanisms, 1.000 vs 0.100 preference recall at matched budget, and 240+ tests. Paper in preparation.

entries.title: allSoft - robot simulation validation
entries.summary: A YAML-driven simulation-in-the-loop harness: PX4 SITL and Gazebo in Docker, MAVSDK missions, and JSON plus SQLite artifacts for regression comparison. 4/4 reference scenarios pass live.

entries.title: This site - rebuilt as a static project site
entries.summary: Moved from a single page to a multi-page static site with a config-driven content pipeline, then hardened after a GitHub Pages failure caused by committed symlinks.

entries.title: Developer guide - building software with AI
entries.summary: A 25,000-word tutorial on building software with AI coding assistants, with role-specific tracks and case studies drawn from production projects. The strongest technical-writing artifact in the portfolio.
